cloudflare-workers-ai.note: GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 need a paid billing method, which is the Workers Paid plan at a $5 monthly minimum. 10,000 neurons a day are free, $0.011 per 1,000 after that.

together.note: Prepaid. The first credit purchase is at least $15, later ones at least $5. The balance does not expire.

hyperbolic.note: A one-time deposit of $5 or more. A free-tier account gets a $1 credit for verifying a phone number.
